summary: Lane dispatch is a registered workflow action (dispatch_worker) reached through concord_work_transition.workflow_action; its D1 policy triple matches start_execution (external_effect, approval none, fenced, generic); the per-action capability is structural — the runtime reads the action's required_capability rather than hard-coding work_transition; the dispatch_worker action requires a new worker_dispatch capability that is registrable in a client policy but structurally non-grantable, mirroring worker_evidence; the worker-dispatch evidence boundary refuses when no authorized, unconsumed dispatch window exists for (work_id, step_id, attempt_epoch), closing the integrity hole a Task-tool spawn used to leave open; the adapter authorizes before spawning.
title: Lane dispatch is a registered workflow action
